summary: Return Node's temporary directory using documented environment-variable precedence and no trailing separator.

semantics.windows_precedence: TEMP, then TMP, then system defaults
semantics.posix_precedence: TMPDIR, then TMP, then TEMP, then /tmp

caveats: Path.GetTempPath commonly includes a trailing separator and uses different environment resolution details.

tests.name: normal no trailing slash
tests.expected_behavior: returns a temporary-directory string without a trailing separator except where root semantics require otherwise
